HPWC_WarcasketHelmet_Hemophage.descripti.english:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with improved impact dispersion and heat protection, equipped with a visor that shields the pilot from sunlight and makes them less likely to flee from fire.

The 10th generation came out of a government program that rebuilt captured pirate rigs around its own power armor and gave them to veterans who could no longer serve any other way. The program has no record of a Hemophage series. Some think the designs were stolen and refitted for sanguophages. Some believe the series was sanctioned in secret from the top of the program, which sanguophages had directed all along.

The Hemophage series runs on its pilot's hemogen. Injectors in the shell keep the pilot's blood pumping even without a heart, and can spend their hemogen quickly to make them much faster and stronger. Servos in the pauldrons can tear a limb off an enemy and leave a wound the pilot can feed from, and the helmet keeps out sunlight and helps the pilot hold their nerve near fire. For a non-hemogenic pilot this series is somewhat lackluster, but it suits a sanguophage who prefers to fight up close.

HPWC_WarcasketTrait_Hemophage.degreeData.english: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on {PAWN_objective}, and {PAWN_pronoun} can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. Because of how bulky the armor is and how much energy it takes to use it, {PAWN_nameDef} is not capable of most work, but can still do intellectual work.

HPWC_Dismember.description.english: Tear an arm or a leg off a nearby target, whatever armor it wears. A limb too sturdy to tear off will only be wounded, and a target with no limbs left will lose its head instead. If the pilot is hemogenic and the target is human, the pilot will then hold on and feed from the wound to gain hemogen, which will also cause the target to lose blood.

HPWC_HemogenRush.description.english: Run the warcasket's injectors, which pump the pilot's own hemogen through their body far faster than it would normally be used. The pilot will move faster and hit harder while their hemogen drains quickly. Toggle again to stop. The injectors will also stop when the pilot runs out of hemogen.
